title: Is Human-Like Text Liked by Humans? Multilingual Human Detection and Preference Against AI

live_model.evidence: Appendix C generation notes, e.g. "articles were generated using the OpenAI's GPT-4o", "meta reviews using GPT-4o-2024-08-06"; Table 3 reports human annotator detection accuracy per dataset.

prompt.location: Appendix C (per-dataset generation prompts), Table 6 (Italian), Table 8 (original vs improved prompts)
prompt.note: Generation prompts printed; GPT-4o is the text generator, not the evaluated system.

claim.metric: human detection accuracy on GPT-4o-generated text

notes: The gpt-4-turbo alias in live_ids is a false hit (the text only contains GPT-3.5-turbo and Qwen-turbo). GPT-4o generates the machine text; every reported number is human-annotator detection accuracy or preference, and where a snapshot is named it is gpt-4o-2024-08-06, not 2024-05-13. Automatic-detection experiments use fine-tuned detectors.
